description: Renovate owns dependency updates for this repository because Dependabot cannot.
GitHub lists Bun as supported for version updates but NOT for security updates, so the
config-free security-update path falls back to the npm_and_yarn updater, which cannot read
bun.lock and fails with dependency_file_not_supported. No .github/dependabot.yml fixes that;
there is no ecosystem entry that unlocks Dependabot security updates for Bun. Renovate has a
dedicated bun manager instead, which reads the text bun.lock and the packages/* workspaces.
Operator coupling worth knowing before changing repository settings: Dependabot ALERTS and the
dependency graph must stay ENABLED even though Dependabot SECURITY UPDATES are turned off.
Renovate's vulnerabilityAlerts reads GitHub's alert feed; disabling alerts blinds it.
Only four keys are set. Everything else this repository wants is already a Renovate default:
the default branch is dev, so PRs already target the working branch; prConcurrentLimit (10)
and prHourlyLimit (2) already bound how fast PRs arrive; and vulnerabilityAlerts is already
active - it has no enabled key to turn on.
The load-bearing setting, and off by default. Most of this repository's exposure is not a
dependency whose declared range is too old - it is a range that already permits a patched
version while the frozen bun.lock resolves to a stale one. That produces no GitHub alert at
all, because the range *could* resolve to something patched. Measured on 2026-08-21:
regenerating bun.lock with every declared range left byte-identical took bun audit from 163
advisories to 24. Deleting the lockfile and running bun install is exactly what Renovate's
bun manager does here, weekly (schedule defaults to 'before 4am on monday').
This is also why the outcome does not lean on vulnerabilityAlerts: that path defaults to
rangeStrategy 'update-lockfile', and Renovate's docs omit bun from the managers supporting
that strategy, so alert-driven PRs may no-op. The scheduled regeneration will not.
Expect the first one to be a large diff. It is the whole lockfile, in its own revertable PR.
